title: Duty Drawback Leak Desk
oneLiner: A trade-finance workbench that surfaces missed customs refund and duty drawback opportunities by SKU, document gap, and expected recoverable cash.
targetUser: Small importer operators, customs finance managers, and export admin teams recovering missed refund cash.
keyUX: Scan recoverable cash by SKU, isolate paperwork blockers, and decide which refund cases to process today.
requiredUISections: per-SKU duty and return trend chart
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop trade-finance operations dashboard called Duty Drawback Leak Desk for small importers and customs finance operators. It should help teams recover missed duty drawback and refund opportunities by connecting imported SKU history, re-export activity, returns, paperwork gaps, and expected recoverable cash into one decision surface. Include a recoverable cash KPI hero, a drawback candidate queue, a per-SKU duty and return trend chart, a document-gap risk panel, a processing action drawer, and a reimbursement timeline rail. Design direction: use a financial analysis aesthetic with deep navy, fog gray, muted emerald, and sharp amber accents; keep charts analytical, tables precise, and the overall product calm, audit-friendly, and cash-recovery focused.
